cost_interpretation: Single execution of each grid cached across policy replay; sum construction-plus-solve observed costs for all meshes a policy would require, including failed attempts. Selection/check overhead reported separately. These are deterministic retrospective replays of frozen prospective rules, not separate randomized wall-clock trials.
